python3 - "$SRC" "$TMP" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw,ImageFont
import json,sys,shutil,hashlib
src=Path(sys.argv[1]); out=Path(sys.argv[2]); pub=out/'review'; pub.mkdir(parents=True)
manifest=json.loads((src/'blind_manifest.json').read_text())
# Primary candidates only: preserve manifest order; do not inspect answer_key.json.
cases=[c for c in manifest['cases'] if c.get('kind')=='BASE_VS_WARP']
font=ImageFont.load_default()
rows_per=6
for si in range(0,len(cases),rows_per):
    group=cases[si:si+rows_per]
    W=1280; rowh=455; H=55+rowh*len(group)
    sheet=Image.new('RGB',(W,H),'#111111'); d=ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
    d.text((12,12),f'BLIND DEPTHWARP REVIEW — sheet {si//rows_per+1} — A/B labels hidden; DO NOT USE answer_key',fill='white',font=font)
    y=50
    for c in group:
        a=Image.open(src/c['A']).convert('RGB'); b=Image.open(src/c['B']).convert('RGB')
        d.text((8,y+4),f"{c['case_id']}  roll={c['roll']}  amp={c['amp']}  eligible={c['objective_eligible']}",fill='white',font=font)
        d.text((8,y+28),'A',fill='white',font=font); d.text((642,y+28),'B',fill='white',font=font)
        sheet.paste(a,(8,y+42)); sheet.paste(b,(642,y+42))
        y+=rowh
    path=pub/f'blind_sheet_{si//rows_per+1:02d}.jpg'; sheet.save(path,quality=94,subsampling=0)
# Copy ONLY public manifest and empty score template; never answer key.
shutil.copy2(src/'blind_manifest.json',pub/'blind_manifest.json')
shutil.copy2(src/'blind_scores.csv',pub/'blind_scores.csv')
(pub/'README.md').write_text('BLINDED REVIEW MATERIAL ONLY. answer_key.json intentionally excluded. Production credit remains zero.\n')
for p in sorted(pub.iterdir()):
    if p.is_file(): print(hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),p.name,p.stat().st_size)
PY
